setting: One setting across slots: speech decoding or synthesis from non-acoustic speech-production signals (any signal type, as in the published tables); M13 narrows to intracranial speech synthesis because the design compared is the participant and implant.

M01.lineage: cued overt keyword reading (communication-board vocabulary of Luo et al. 2023, same participant)

M02.lineage: participant's own time-aligned overt speech as acoustic target (LPCNet features), as in Angrick 2019/Herff 2019

M03.lineage: single training over 10 recording days, frozen model, per-day high-gamma normalization from syllable-repetition baseline

M04.lineage: overt, self-paced keyword production by a dysarthric speaker

M05.lineage: two 8x8 clinical subdural ECoG grids, 64 selected channels, 70-170 Hz high-gamma

topics.inclusion_rule: reused published topic table (online synthesis with playback; offline studies only when they simulate causal frame-level inference)
topics.design_field: classification at target time: closed loop with playback vs offline; frame-causal vs segment-level delayed playback

M07.lineage: no language model or lexicon at use time

M08.lineage: LPCNet vocoder from 18 Bark cepstra + 2 pitch parameters, own voice

M11.lineage: participant's own overt speech as reference

topics.inclusion_rule: reused published topic table (human listener transcription or identification of speech synthesized from non-acoustic signals)
topics.design_field: closed-set identification vs open transcription; chance level; exclusions

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies that reconstruct speech acoustics from intracranial recordings made during produced, attempted or imagined speech (the published intracranial-synthesis population pattern of M08/intracranial-synthesis-waveform-generation), classified by who was recorded and with what implant: acute clinical monitoring (epilepsy) or intraoperative recordings in people with intact speech, versus a chronic research implant in a person with impaired speech (ALS, brainstem stroke, locked-in, anarthria, dysarthria). Boundary: full-text pattern counts with the reference list removed, so related-work mentions count (upper bounds); a study counts under every design it names; heard-speech reconstruction and text-only decoders are outside; versions once.
topics.design_field: full-text regex: epilepsy, intraoperative, impaired-speech population, chronic implant / clinical trial
topics.metric: listener accuracy %; months from training to test
